mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.owner_user_id, m.merchant_name, m.status, c.merchant_type_code, c.city_code, a.status AS application_status, CASE WHEN acc.accepted_at IS NULL THEN 'NOT_SIGNED' ELSE 'SIGNED' END AS signing_status FROM merchant m LEFT JOIN merchant_profile_compat c ON c.merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN merchant_application a ON a.reserved_merchant_id = m.id LEFT JOIN merchant_agreement_current cur ON cur.agreement_key = 'MERCHANT' LEFT JOIN merchant_agreement_acceptance acc ON acc.merchant_id = m.id AND acc.agreement_version_id = cur.agreement_version_id WHERE m.id = #{merchantId}
